create_RemoveImageAnnotationsByRatio: create a RemoveImageAnnotationsByRatio pipeline step with a given alpha-to-character ratio threshold
run_RemoveImageAnnotationsByRatio: run the RemoveImageAnnotationsByRatio pipeline step on a dataset of documents to filter image annotations
remove_low_alpha_annotations: remove image annotations where the alpha character ratio falls below a specified threshold
filter_docling_picture_annotations: filter docling picture annotation tags by evaluating the alphabetic character ratio of their content
process_document_pages: process document pages by applying regex-based annotation removal and computing page offsets
